title: Wistia Pricing 2026: Plans, Costs, and Limits
summary: Wistia pricing structures determine your monthly expenses based on specific video counts and user seats. Evaluate these tiers to select the right package.
body_markdown:
## Automating Video Workflows to Control Wistia Costs


### Syncing Turnstile leads to your CRM automatically


Automating lead ingestion from Wistia Turnstile ensures that you don't have to manually export CSV files to move viewer data into your sales funnel.


When a viewer enters their email address into the Turnstile email capture gate, the workflow immediately pushes that contact into a CRM like Salesforce.


Salesforce is the enterprise platform for managing customer relationships and sales pipelines. This immediate synchronization prevents the lead decay that occurs when data sits unaddressed in a hosting platform's local storage.


Per-seat pricing models often ration access to these automations, creating a bottleneck where only a few licensed users can manage the video stack.


Activepieces removes this friction by metering by consumption rather than headcount, allowing unlimited flows on every plan so that adding a team member to the workflow costs nothing until they run an automation.


Alan and Funding Societies run production automation on Activepieces, and the credit-based structure that makes headcount irrelevant to cost is published on the Activepieces pricing page.


The following workflow demonstrates how an automated agent handles the handoff between marketing triggers and sales actions.


> The screenshot shows a multi-step workflow builder. A HubSpot trigger for a new lead initiates a sequence involving an AI Agent for lead qualification, followed by conditional logic that routes the contact to Salesforce and notifies your team via Slack.


By visualizing the logic, you can see exactly where a viewer's data travels once they interact with a video. This visibility allows you to audit the path from "Play" to "Purchase" without navigating fragmented analytics dashboards.


### Triggering social posts when new videos go live


Connecting the Wistia library to social distribution channels removes the friction of manual uploads. It ensures every new asset immediately reaches its intended audience.


A workflow can detect when a video status changes to "Live" in the Wistia dashboard. It then triggers a sequence of posts across platforms like LinkedIn or X.


To ensure the content is native to each feed, you'll use Gemini 3.8 Flash to parse the video description and generate platform-specific captions. Gemini 3.8 Flash is Google's most intelligent Flash model for agentic software engineering.


This automation means a single upload in the hosting environment fulfills the distribution requirements for your entire marketing mix.


### Archiving old videos to stay under plan limits


Moving underutilized assets to cold storage is the most effective way to prevent the exponential cost increases associated with Wistia’s per-video pricing tiers. An automated cleanup script can monitor the "Last Viewed" date for every asset in your account.


The script identifies videos that haven't been accessed in over sixty days. Once identified, the workflow downloads the source file and its associated VTT caption files.


It uploads them to an Amazon S3 bucket (a scalable object storage service) and then deletes the asset from the Wistia library. This process keeps the active asset count below the threshold of the next pricing tier while preserving the original content for future use.
